TYPE | Rezoning Attachment
2308 West 18" Place
From RT-4 to B2-5

The Property

‘The subject property is located in an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District and is located in a
Transit Served Location per the Equitable Transit-Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance and is located
approximately 530.0" from the METRA Westem Station, approximately 980.0" from the Westem CTA Traia Station
entrance, and approximately 480.0” fron the CTA Western Bus Corridor (Route 49).

The Property is improved with a ewo-story front residential building (28’-4" in height) that includes two residential units and
a fear two story residential building (23°-3” in height) that includes four residential units. There is no parking.

The Project

2308 BUYERS LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to convert both buildings into one building by
constracting a middle addition and a third floor that will connect both buildings. The new building will include a new height
of 42’-0". The Applicant also will add two new residential units to the single combined building for a total of eight dwelling
units on the property. Fhe Applicant will provide two bicycle spaces, No parking is proposed.

The subject rezoning application also seeks Type-I relief to reduce parking from two spaces to zero as the property qualifies

for ETOD parking reduction under section 17-13-0303-D and 17-10-0102-B and also seeks variation relief under section 17-

13-1101-B to reduce the required side yard setbacks from a combined 5.0’ to 0.27’ (west side existing), provide a 3.09" east side setback,
reduce the front yard setback from 3.68’ to 2.89" (existing), and reduce the rear yard setback from 30.0’ to 15.58"

(existing).

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from an RT-4
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:
